_comment: 俺たちに翼はない (MAGES, Vita): sprites 34-48 are the button bar. The cut-ins (chr\st_cin*, 960x540) are centred, 2 px above the bottom edge, and mostly transparent (st_cin022 shows x 365-595 only), so one moved out to x -220 (99 exits) is gone though its box isn't; the static (sprite 60) and the light balls etc. (59) are full-screen overlays; impacts (and the battle scenes' blows) play one SE several times a few hundred ms apart, as the source does (auto-play shortens the waits); SpriteMove runs as a timed amsp/print loop (conv_move_loop), slow only because it keeps real time; a CharacterMove to :Color alpha 0 fades a character out, and the script deletes it later (invisible meanwhile, as in the original)
_engine_vars: engine_vars: the global flags endings_menu_init (0x81066564, test at 0x8106687c) reads to open an album card; ours opens every card (docs/games/oretsuba.md). [GlobalFlag] n is %410+n in 0.txt (mages/convert.rs GLOBAL_FLAG_BASE)
